leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a basic incident alerting mechanism using a simulated webhook endpoint.
Construct a status dashboard component that displays real-time service health metrics.
Configure a simple error boundary to capture and report frontend failures.
Integrate a logging utility to record incident details and recovery actions.
Apply a retry strategy for failed API calls to improve service reliability.
Initialize a mock incident response workflow with defined escalation steps.
Manipulate system state to simulate and recover from a degraded service condition.
